source: Hype Cup roster of 28 Oct 2026 (built by tools/original_league.py cup from the original-league tables); rules: backgammon-ladder-cup brief, Part 2, with the amendments of 27 and 28 Oct 2026
name: Hype Cup
roster_rule: Teams from the original-league tables: each setup in its original league, only matches within it count (3 points a win, 1 a draw, 0 a loss; tiebreak: head-to-head, then the lower error rate; rule set on 28 Oct, after the ties were known). The top 2 models of each table and the two best 3rd places by error rate; programs and late entries are not eligible.
honesty: The Cup is an event. The error rate is the ranking.
stored_rule: Two setups play each other once: a pairing already played in a league stands, and the bracket shows where it was played.
level_rule: A level match goes to the setup with the lower error rate in that match.

knockout.name: Nackgammon knockout

knockout.about: The same 8 teams and the same draw, every game from the Nackgammon start; otherwise the league match rules.
